question: Why does Bhairava praise the goddess for asking about this rare teaching?
premises: He states that he has been asked a question.
The matter asked about is difficult even for gods to obtain.
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because she has asked about a teaching that is rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O Great Goddess! You have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
